description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of two models, Audio-Reasoner and Qwen-2.5-Omni, across two categories, MMAU and MMAR. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, with the model names displayed below each pair of bars. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. Each model has two bars, colored blue for MMAU and purple for MMAR, as indicated by the legend. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 59%, while the MMAR bar is around 35%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar is at about 64%, and the MMAR bar is at approximately 56%. The bars are grouped by model, with MMAU and MMAR bars appearing together for each model. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
